description: Source code for the TransactionQueue class in the Orleans framework, managing transactional state and coordinating two-phase commits, aborts, and recovery operations.

classes.name: TransactionQueue<TState>
classes.description: Manages the queuing, persistence, commit, and abort handling for transactions within Orleans, supporting recovery and consistency.

classes.name: PreparedMessages
classes.description: Holds the count and status of prepared messages associated with specific timestamps for transactional coordination.

methods.name: EnqueueCommit
methods.description: Enqueues a transaction record for committing, handling different commit roles, and persisting their state.

methods.name: NotifyOfPrepared
methods.description: Handles notification that a transaction has been prepared, updating internal queues and state accordingly.

methods.name: NotifyOfPrepare
methods.description: Handles notification for remote prepare requests, validating lock, updating timestamp, and state.

methods.name: NotifyOfAbort
methods.description: Handles notification for aborts, updating resources and transaction states, and notifying relevant parties.

methods.name: NotifyOfPing
methods.description: Handles ping notifications, used to check transaction liveliness and trigger aborts if necessary.

methods.name: NotifyOfConfirm
methods.description: Handles confirmation notifications from remote TMs about commit completion.

methods.name: NotifyOfCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation requests for transactions, aborting and cleaning up as needed.

methods.name: NotifyOfRestore
methods.description: Restores transaction state from storage during activation or recovery.

methods.name: GetMostRecentState
methods.description: Returns the most recent stable state and sequence number.

methods.name: BatchableOperationsCount
methods.description: Counts how many operations at the end of the queue are batchable.

methods.name: StorageWork
methods.description: Performs storage-related work such as checkpointing, resuming prepared transactions, and cleaning up.

methods.name: AbortAndRestore
methods.description: Initiates abort and restore operations after a failure.

methods.name: Bail
methods.description: Performs cleanup of transactions and deactivates the grain if needed.

methods.name: CheckProgressOfCommitQueue
methods.description: Checks and acts on progress and timeout conditions within the commit queue.

methods.name: CollectEventsForBatch
methods.description: Collects commit, prepare, and read events into a storage batch.

methods.name: OnLocalCommit
methods.description: Handles local commit logic, including preparing storage and sending responses.
